answer: Resonance attestation stops Sybils: each identity must strike one basalt slab and shine its flash through the prism, the keeper reading its spectrum while the echo of the strike lands in the same second. A forged spectrum fails the split; a real one costs a day at the quarry face and a signed strike record. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 struck slabs at $1,800 each in quarry fees and keeper time, $1,800,000 struck, for identities whose light never matches the stone.
